visualCharacteristics.purpose: Equal-width bordered contact cards with title, description and full-width button
visualCharacteristics.description: 2 equal bordered rounded cards, each with H3 title, short description and full-width outlined blue button.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card, single cell: heading, description paragraph, CTA link alone in a paragraph (external links such as wa.me open in a new tab). An optional image cell is supported
contentPattern.blockContent: 2 bordered contact cards with title, description and outlined button
contentPattern.source: One single-cell row per card: H3 title, description paragraph, CTA link (wa.me URLs).

reuseGuidance: Reuse for text-only action cards. Use cards-product for priced items.
